scoring_justification: Cannot recompute from raw DFT outputs within checker; comparing reported summary quantities to paper-reported values with tolerances is the feasible tier.

outputs.description: Reproduced quantities for NO dissociation on CuO(110). All values are compared to the paper-reported DFT results with pre-defined tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The solver must produce these quantities from their own DFT calculations using Quantum ESPRESSO with SSSP PBE pseudopotentials. The CI-NEB step may require significant CPU time; the solving agent is expected to run it on external compute and bring the final artifacts back.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for each field in results.json
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures and text: surface_contraction (0.11 Å), adsorption_energy_molecular (-1.78 eV), N_O_bond_length (1.30 Å), coadsorption energy (-1.57 eV), transition_state_energy (-0.70 eV), activation_barrier (1.07 eV).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper as reported computed results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct transcription from the paper's reported numbers; no arbitrary synthesis.
